item.description: The Randall County Sheriff's Office reports that it will begin its 43rd Jail Academy.

item.title: Amarillo Little Theatre: Jersey Boys Classic Car Show
item.description: The Amarillo Little Theatre invites the community to the Jersey Boys Classic Car Show on Sunday.

item.title: Volunteers take part in the Point-In-Time Count
item.description: Volunteers and outreach workers spread out across Amarillo on Friday as part of the city's annual Point-In-Time Count, an effort aimed at better understanding homelessness through in-person surveys and direct interaction with people living without stable housing.

item.title: Federal judge orders release of 5-year-old boy, father from Texas immigrant detention center
item.description: A five-year-old boy and his father, who have been in custody at a federal detention center in Texas after they were detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement in Minneapolis, are to be released from custody after a Saturday ruling from a federal judge in Texas.

item.title: Amarillo ISD sweeps Potter County Spelling Bee
item.description: On Friday, Amarillo ISD swept the Happy State Bank Potter County Spelling Bee, claiming the top three spots in the competition.

item.title: State of Texas: Agreements between law enforcement agencies and ICE rise as new law takes effect
item.description: One year into the second term of President Donald Trump, his administration’s focus on undocumented immigrants has intensified, drawing outrage in recent weeks following shootings by Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents. Protests have broken out across the country, including in Texas, where local law enforcement agencies have hurried to sign up as force multipliers to help ICE achieve its stated mission “to make your community safer.”

item.title: Middle school students compete at Pantex Regional Science Bowl
item.description: Middle school students from across the Texas Panhandle put their science knowledge to the test Saturday during the Pantex Regional Middle School Science Bowl, competing for scholarships, prize money and a chance to advance to the national level.
